purpose: Define explicit retention, expiry and deletion semantics for memory records without conflating deletion of a memory projection with deletion of its source data.

topics.name: Memory Retention and Deletion
topics.purpose: Define explicit retention, expiry and deletion semantics for memory records without conflating deletion of a memory projection with deletion of its source data.

semantics.retention_rule: Retention/expiry policy is explicit per memory scope/profile where applicable.
semantics.expiry_rule: Expired records become unavailable according to policy and lifecycle state.
semantics.source_rule: Deleting memory does not delete referenced source objects unless a separate authorized source deletion operation exists.
semantics.lineage_rule: Required audit/tombstone evidence may remain according to policy without retaining deleted content.
semantics.failure_rule: Partial deletion state is explicit and never represented as complete success.

invariants.rule: Memory and retrieved context are provenance-bearing inert data projections; remembered or retrieved content never becomes authority, canonical truth or executable instruction merely by inclusion in context.

hard_gates.condition: memory delete cascades to source silently
record deleted by fuzzy content match
